newsitem.title: USA: ILEX, MPI Development in anticancer compound pact.
newsitem.headline: ILEX, MPI Development in anticancer compound pact.

text.p: ILEX Oncology Inc and MPI Development said on Thursday they formed a limited partnership to develop piritrexim, a DNA synthesis inhibitor to be used for the treatment of bladder and other cancers.
ILEX and MPI said they would jointly own and manage the new venture and share equally in piritrexim's future. The inhibitor is also being developed to treat early stage Kaposi's sarcoma.

Under the agreement, ILEX said it licensed development and marketing rights for piritrexim to the newly formed venture in exchange for a licensing fee, milestone payments and royalties. The two privately-held companies said they would contribute equal amounts to capitalize the venture.
In addition, MPI said it made made a $5 million equity investment in ILEX Oncology. Jerry Mitchell, chief executive officer of MPI Development, would also join ILEX's board.
